user.description: Create a new matrix: give it a name, then add its rows and columns as labels.

data_description.name: A name for this matrix, e.g. "Climate Profiles".
data_description.rows: Row labels, e.g. "Comfort", "Eco", "Sleep" -- type a label and press Enter to add it.
data_description.columns: Column labels, e.g. "Living Room", "Office", "Bedroom" -- type a label and press Enter to add it.

error.rows_required: At least one row is required.
error.columns_required: At least one column is required.

init.description: Edit this matrix's rows and columns. A label not in the new list is removed (its data is discarded); a new label starts at null.

data_description.rows: Row labels, e.g. "Comfort", "Eco", "Sleep" -- type a label and press Enter to add it. A label not in this list is removed (its data is discarded); a new label starts at null.
data_description.columns: Column labels, e.g. "Living Room", "Office", "Bedroom" -- type a label and press Enter to add it. A label not in this list is removed (its data is discarded); a new label starts at null.

error.rows_required: At least one row is required.
error.columns_required: At least one column is required.

set_cell.name: Set cell
set_cell.description: Sets (or clears) a single cell in a matrix.

row.name: Row
row.description: The row to update, by label ("Comfort") or key ("comfort").

column.name: Column
column.description: The column to update, by label ("Living Room") or key ("living_room").

value.name: Value
value.description: The new value. Leave empty to clear the cell.

set_row.name: Set row
set_row.description: Updates one or more cells in a row. Columns not listed are left unchanged.

row.name: Row
row.description: The row to update, by label or key.

values.name: Values
values.description: A mapping of column (label or key) to new value, or null to clear.

set_column.name: Set column
set_column.description: Updates one or more cells in a column. Rows not listed are left unchanged.

column.name: Column
column.description: The column to update, by label or key.

values.name: Values
values.description: A mapping of row (label or key) to new value, or null to clear.

set_values.name: Set values
set_values.description: Updates any number of cells at once. Cells not listed are left unchanged.

values.name: Values
values.description: A nested mapping of row, then column (labels or keys), to new value, or null to clear.

fill.name: Fill
fill.description: Sets every cell to the same value — or only the cells in one row and/or column.

value.name: Value
value.description: The value to set. Leave empty to clear the cells.

row.name: Row
row.description: Only fill this row (label or key).

column.name: Column
column.description: Only fill this column (label or key).

adjust.name: Adjust
adjust.description: Adds an amount to every cell that has a value — or only the cells in one row and/or column. Empty cells are left empty.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: The amount to add. Use a negative number to subtract.

row.name: Row
row.description: Only adjust this row (label or key).

column.name: Column
column.description: Only adjust this column (label or key).
